text: Binary per-row judgment of the OP's own voice in the title and argument columns (current text, including marked edits): outputs 1 if beliefs and reasons are stated with no emotional self-defense, meaning no expressed fear, anxiety, hurt, defensiveness, or self-protective emotional appeal about themselves or their standing with others. Outputs 0 if any such self-defense is present, including fear of social rejection or isolation. Quoted or reported statements by other people are excluded unless the OP adopts them. Ignore view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and text reporting the outcome; generic discussion of delta or platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may count if relevant. Do not reconstruct an original version by removing edits. Returns null if title and argument are both missing, empty, or malformed.
